description: The qualification list of the tender, with literal excerpts: conditions, exceptions and evidence by page of the available analysis. The lookup does not start another analysis. Deadlines, proposals and the other obligations are in the dossier; this list covers qualification and the required attestations, and does not state what the company has.

acesso_codigo.description: Authorizes this document for whoever holds it. A purchase made with the account session issues no code: the global right of the account (HttpOnly cookie) applies, and the right of the guest edm_… applies with its token. A public receipt grants no access.

agent_pass.description: Individual agent credential, required together with X-Editalmd-Avaliacao.

avaliacao_codigo.description: evaluation.access_code of the sponsored premium, only for this document and agent, with an expiry. Use it together with X-Agent-Pass; it is not a receipt or a purchase.
